content_sections.heading: BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
BEL Deputy Engineer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: BEL has announced a total of 14 vacancies for Deputy Engineer E-II (FTE) posts. The discipline-wise and category-wise vacancy details are given below.

content_sections.heading: BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the required educational qualification, discipline and age criteria mentioned in the official notification. Candidates should have a full-time B.E./B.Tech degree in the relevant discipline from an AICTE-approved college/institute or recognised university. Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Communication / Electronics & Telecommunication / Telecommunication Engineering Mechanical Engineering Computer Science / Computer Science Engineering UR, EWS and OBC(NCL) candidates should have First Class, while SC, ST and PwBD candidates should have Pass Class in the required qualification.

rows.eligible_subjects: Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Electronics & Telecommunication, Communication, Telecommunication
Computer Science, Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science Engineering

content_sections.heading: BEL Deputy Engineer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026 is 28 years as on 01 September 2026. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: BEL Deputy Engineer Salary Structure 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for Deputy Engineer E-II (FTE) posts will receive salary as per the pay scale mentioned below. Apart from basic pay, candidates will receive Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, 35% of basic pay as perquisites, Performance Related Pay (PRP), Group Insurance, Medical facilities and Provident Fund as per company rules.

content_sections.heading: BEL Deputy Engineer Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates have to pay the application fee through SBI Collect. SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from payment of application fee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official BEL website. Open the Careers section. Select the Deputy Engineer E-II (FTE) Recruitment 2026 notification. Register and fill in the online application form. Upload required documents and certificates. Pay the application fee through SBI Collect, if applicable. Submit the application form before 23 September 2026. Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for BEL Deputy Engineer Application
content_sections.text: SSLC/Matriculation Certificate PUC/12th Class/Diploma Marks Card (if applicable) B.E./B.Tech Marks Cards B.E./B.Tech Degree Certificate CGPA conversion formula (if applicable) Post-qualification experience certificates Category certificates, if applicable SBI Fee Payment Receipt, if applicable The notification specifies the documents required to be uploaded along with the online application form.

content_sections.heading: BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026 consists of the following stages: Shortlisting based on application and submitted documents Written Test Interview Shortlisted candidates will be called for a Written Test of 85 marks. Based on Written Test performance, candidates will be shortlisted for interview in a 1:5 ratio category-wise.

content_sections.heading: BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026 Written Test
content_sections.text: Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted for the Written Test after screening of applications and documents. The selection will be through Written Test followed by Interview for candidates who qualify in the written examination.

content_sections.heading: BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. Candidates must ensure that their degree discipline matches the advertised discipline. Applicants working in PSU/Government organizations must submit NOC during the interview. Candidates should be willing to travel extensively across India.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BEL has announced 14 vacancies for Deputy Engineer E-II (FTE) posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 23 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a full-time B.E./B.Tech degree in Electronics, Mechanical or Computer Science-related disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years as on 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of BEL Deputy Engineer E-II posts?
faq.answer: The pay scale is Rs. 40,000 - 3% - Rs. 1,40,000 along with applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 400 plus 18% GST. SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from payment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Written Test and Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job location for BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. The recruitment is on a Fixed Tenure Basis initially for 5 years, extendable up to 2 years based on requirements.
